name: mnemos
description: Mnemos IDE integrations for Claude Code, published from the Mnemos source repository

plugins.name: mnemos-agents
plugins.description: Streams Claude Code session events (cwd, prompts, responses, tool calls, permission/idle state) to the Mnemos agents panel via OSC 777.

plugins.name: mnemos-team
plugins.description: Start and manage Claude Code sessions in panes next to yours in a Mnemos project tab, through Mnemos's local team MCP server (opt-in: agents.team.enabled).
